title: BPN October Meetup - Fly Boy Donuts

raw_data.description: Join Brookings Professional Network (BPN) for our Monthly Meetup, a casual and welcoming opportunity to connect with fellow professionals in the Brookings area.Each month, we partner with a local business to host this event, giving you the chance to experience a new space while building meaningful connections. This month, we're excited to gather at Fly Boy Donuts, where attendees can enjoy great conversation, a relaxed atmosphere, and the opportunity to expand their network.Whether you're new to the community or a long-time professional, BPN Meetups are designed to help you build relationships, share ideas, and stay connected.
